NinMagic Shop console logo atlas
===============================

Asset: assets/romfs/theme/shop-console-logos.png

The RetroSystem console pictograms and Systematic Nintendo Switch 2 pictogram
are by the RetroArch Assets / Libretro contributors, licensed under Creative
Commons Attribution 4.0 International. The atlas crops, rescales, and adjusts
their brightness for the console menu.

RetroSystem source:
https://github.com/libretro/retroarch-assets/tree/8c918e2872482139273374ef4cc6c7aff34d7585/xmb/retrosystem/png
Systematic source:
https://github.com/libretro/retroarch-assets/blob/8c918e2872482139273374ef4cc6c7aff34d7585/xmb/systematic/png/Nintendo%20-%20Switch%202.png
Upstream licensing notice:
https://github.com/libretro/retroarch-assets/blob/8c918e2872482139273374ef4cc6c7aff34d7585/COPYING
CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Nintendo console symbols identify their corresponding platforms. The atlas
includes the following rasterized artwork from Wikimedia Commons, whose file
pages record the indicated copyright status:

- Nintendo Switch, by Nintendo. Public domain, simple geometry. Light variant.
  https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Nintendo_Switch_Logo_(without_text).svg
- Wii, by Nintendo. Public domain, text logo. Light variant.
  https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Wii.svg
- Nintendo GameCube symbol, by Yoshii Lizcano. CC0 1.0.
  https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Nintendo_GameCube_symbol_logo.svg
- Nintendo 3DS, by Nintendo. Public domain, text logo. Cropped light variant.
  https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Nintendo_3DS_logo.svg
- Nintendo DS icon, by Nintendo. Public domain, simple geometry. Light variant.
  https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Nintendo_DS_Icon.svg

The platform names and marks belong to their respective owners.
The Ports pictogram was drawn for NinMagic Shop.
